annotations.title: Create a local rank grid config

description: Creates a geo-grid rank-tracking config: a 3x3 grid of points around a centre coordinate, checking ORGANIC rank for one keyword and domain from each point. centerLabel must name the place the grid is centred on — a heatmap with no stated centre is a claim about nowhere. Run it with run_local_rank_grid and read it with get_local_rank_grid. FREE: database only.

centerLabel.description: What the centre point is called, e.g. 'Manchester city centre'.

domain.description: Domain whose organic rank is checked.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: create_local_rank_grid_config
